global.description: Platform values: the context (platform/platform-values.yaml, global.okdp), never an instance's.

imageTag.title: Image tag
imageTag.description: Server image tag. Set explicitly so the deployed image is pinned; empty, the upstream half of the package version.

consoleHost.title: Console host
consoleHost.description: Console host, used verbatim as the single allowed origin. Defaults to okdp-ui.<ingress suffix>.

insecureOciRegistries.title: Insecure OCI registries
insecureOciRegistries.description: Registry hosts reachable over plain HTTP, comma separated. A sandbox concern, empty anywhere else.

gitops.title: Deployments repositories
gitops.description: The Git repositories the server commits the desired state to, and the engine reconciling them: one repository (repoURL, branch, path), or the topology of several.

repoURL.title: Repository URL
repoURL.description: https://…, ssh://… or git@host:org/repo.git (GITOPS_REPO_URL): the one repository holding platform/, projects/ and the compiled output. Required unless topology is set.

path.title: Path
path.description: Directory holding the layout (platform/, projects/), empty for the root (GITOPS_PATH).

topology.title: Topology
topology.description: Where the platform, the projects and the compiled output live, each a repository (url, branch, path; the projects' url and path may hold {project}), and the Forgejo the server creates the project repositories in. Written to a ConfigMap mounted at /etc/okdp/gitops/topology.yaml (GITOPS_CONFIG), forgejo.tokenFile set to the token of forgejoTokenSecret. Empty: repoURL, branch and path hold everything.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: The platform's sources: platform-values.yaml, connections/, components/, catalog.yaml, projects.yaml.

path.description: The directory of the repository, empty for its root.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Each project's sources (project.yaml, connections/, services/): {project} in url or path is the project's name.

path.description: The directory of the repository, empty for its root.

output.title: Output
output.description: The directory holding compiled/, flux/ and argocd/: what Flux and Argo CD read.

path.description: The directory of the repository, empty for its root.

forgejo.title: Forgejo
forgejo.description: The Forgejo the server creates a new project's repository okdp-project-<project> in (split topology); its token is the key token of forgejoTokenSecret.

url.description: The Forgejo API base URL, e.g. http://forgejo-http.forgejo.svc.cluster.local:3000.

forgejoTokenSecret.title: Forgejo token secret
forgejoTokenSecret.description: Secret of the release namespace whose key token is the Forgejo API token, mounted at /etc/okdp/forgejo/token. Required with topology.forgejo.

chartCacheDir.title: Chart cache directory
chartCacheDir.description: Where the server pulls the upstream charts it checks the compiled values against (GITOPS_CHART_CACHE_DIR), an emptyDir. Empty: the server's default, under its clone.

releasesNamespace.title: Releases namespace
releasesNamespace.description: Namespace of the Flux HelmReleases and values ConfigMaps, including okdp-platform-values.

argocdNamespace.title: Argo CD namespace
argocdNamespace.description: Namespace of the Argo CD Applications.

credentialsSecret.title: Credentials secret
credentialsSecret.description: Secret with write access to the repositories (Flux GitRepository keys: username/password, bearerToken, or identity/known_hosts).

keycloak.title: Keycloak user management
keycloak.description: Keycloak Admin REST API backing the console's user and group management. Off while credentialsSecret.name is empty. The service account needs the realm-management roles view-users, query-users, manage-users and query-groups.

url.title: Keycloak URL
url.description: Base URL, without /realms/... (KEYCLOAK_URL). Empty: derived from the platform OIDC issuer.

realm.title: Realm
realm.description: Realm of the Admin API (KEYCLOAK_REALM). Empty: derived from the platform OIDC issuer.

credentialsSecret.title: Credentials secret
credentialsSecret.description: Secret in the release namespace with the service-account client credentials. The default keys match identity.provisioning.keycloak.credentialsSecret, so the same Secret can be reused.

tlsInsecure.title: Skip the TLS check
tlsInsecure.description: Skip the Keycloak certificate check (KEYCLOAK_TLS_INSECURE). Sandboxes only.
